description.subject: Young East Asian woman, around early 20s, fair skin, very long straight black hair falling past the shoulders with a few strands in front, dark eyes, natural makeup with soft rosy lips, neutral confident expression
description.pose: Standing full body facing camera with a slight lean, weight on one leg, right hand resting loosely at her side, left hand tucked into the front jeans pocket, looking directly at the camera

clothing.top: Oversized black short-sleeve crew-neck t-shirt with green bold text reading 'REBEL SOUL' (printed mirrored in the image) across the chest, hem partly tucked at one side
clothing.bottom: Light-wash baggy straight-leg blue jeans with ripped knees showing frayed white threads, large green graffiti-style lettering painted on the lower legs
clothing.footwear: Black and white high-top sneakers with a swoosh-style side logo
clothing.accessories: Layered silver chain necklaces with a small cross pendant, chunky silver chain bracelet on the left wrist, silver wallet chain hanging from the jeans pocket

description.setting: Minimal studio with a plain light grey / off-white wall and a smooth grey floor, no props
description.lighting: Strong directional key light from the front right casting a large sharp shadow of the subject on the wall to her left, otherwise even soft studio light
description.composition: Vertical full-body shot from head to sneakers, subject slightly right of center, camera at roughly waist height, large negative space with the cast shadow on the left side; small sparkle watermark at the bottom right corner
description.style: Clean streetwear fashion lookbook / e-commerce photography, photorealistic, crisp detail
description.colors: Black, kelly green accents, light denim blue, silver, white and grey neutrals
description.mood: Cool, confident, urban, edgy streetwear attitude
